name: Reseller Agreement
description: Appoint a reseller in a territory, exclusive or not: discount tiers (Schedule A), resale-price freedom, end-user terms, reporting, marks, anti-bribery and export, and a renewal tail.

body.p: This Reseller Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective}} between {{fontara_entity}} ("Fontara"), and **{{reseller}}**, {{reseller_entity}} with its principal place of business at {{reseller_address}}, {{reseller_city}}, {{reseller_region}} {{reseller_postal}} ("Reseller").

then.p: Fontara appoints Reseller as a non-exclusive authorized reseller of the Fontara subscription services in Fontara's then-current price list (the "Products") to end customers located in {{territory}} (the "Territory"). Fontara may appoint other resellers and sell directly in the Territory.

Fontara appoints Reseller as its exclusive authorized reseller of the Fontara subscription services in Fontara's then-current price list (the "Products") to end customers located in {{territory}} (the "Territory"), and will not appoint another reseller there while Reseller meets a minimum annual commitment of {{currency}}{{min_commit}} in Product purchases. Fontara may still sell directly to end customers in the Territory and to the global accounts it names in writing. If Reseller misses the minimum commitment in a contract year, Fontara may make the appointment non-exclusive by notice.

body.p: Reseller buys the Products from Fontara at Fontara's list price less the discount for Reseller's tier in Schedule A, set each contract year by Reseller's bookings in the prior year. Reseller is free to set its own resale prices. An order binds Fontara when Fontara accepts it; Fontara invoices on acceptance, and Reseller pays {{payment_terms}} from the invoice date, whether or not its customer has paid it.

Reseller shall ensure that each end customer accepts Fontara's then-current end-user subscription terms before using the Products, and shall make no commitment about the Products inconsistent with those terms or Fontara's documentation. Fontara provides the Products and support to end customers under those terms.

Within 10 business days after each calendar quarter Reseller shall report to Fontara its pipeline and each sale (end customer, Products, quantities and term), and shall keep accurate records of its sales for 3 years, which Fontara may audit once a year on reasonable notice.

Fontara grants Reseller a non-exclusive license during the term to use Fontara's trademarks in the Territory solely to market the Products, in line with Fontara's brand guidelines. Reseller shall not register any company name, domain name or trademark that includes a Fontara mark.

Reseller shall comply with the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the UK Bribery Act 2010 and all other applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws, and with applicable export control and sanctions laws. Reseller shall not offer, promise, give or accept anything of value, directly or through others, to improperly influence any person, including any government official, to obtain or retain business. Reseller shall keep accurate books and records of its activities under this Agreement, certify its compliance annually on request, and permit Fontara to audit those records on reasonable notice.
Reseller shall not sell the Products to any person, or for use in any country, that export control or sanctions laws prohibit.

Each party shall keep confidential the non-public information the other discloses under this Agreement that is marked or identified as confidential, or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential, use it only to perform this Agreement, and protect it with reasonable care, during this Agreement and for 3 years after it ends. This does not apply to information that is public, independently developed, or rightfully received from a third party without restriction, or to a disclosure the law requires.

Each party shall comply with the data protection laws that apply to personal data it shares with the other, and Fontara processes end-customer personal data under its own terms with each end customer.

Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages or lost profits, and each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the amounts paid and payable under it in the 12 months before the claim, except for breach of the Confidentiality or Anti-Bribery, Export and Sanctions sections, Reseller's payment obligations, or fraud or willful misconduct.

This Agreement runs for an initial term of {{initial_term}} and then renews for one-year periods unless either party gives 90 days' notice of non-renewal. Either party may terminate it for the other's material breach not cured within 30 days after notice, immediately for a breach of the Anti-Bribery, Export and Sanctions section, or on the other's insolvency.

When this Agreement ends, Reseller's appointment and trademark license end. End-customer subscriptions in effect continue for their current term. For {{tail}} after the end date Reseller may renew each of them once at its then-current discount, after which Fontara may serve those customers directly.

The parties are independent contractors. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, fiduciary or employment relationship between them, and neither party may make any commitment binding the other.

Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and delivered by hand, by recognized overnight courier or by email to the addresses stated in this Agreement or later notified in writing. A notice is effective on confirmed delivery or, for email, when the recipient acknowledges it. Notices of breach, termination or a legal claim must be sent by courier, with a copy by email.

Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, which may not be unreasonably withheld, except that either party may assign it on written notice to an affiliate, or to a successor to all or substantially all of the business or assets to which it relates that assumes it in writing. Any other attempted assignment is void. This Agreement binds and benefits the parties and their permitted successors and assigns.

then.p: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be finally settled by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, before a single arbitrator, seated in San Francisco, California, and judgment on the award may be entered in any court of competent jurisdiction. Either party may seek injunctive relief from a court to protect its confidential information or intellectual property.

This Agreement, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the law of England and Wales. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days. A dispute not resolved in that time shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules, which are incorporated by reference into this section, before a sole arbitrator, with the seat of arbitration in London and English as the language of the arbitration. Either party may seek urgent injunctive relief from a court.

This Agreement, and any non-contractual obligation arising out of or in connection with it, is governed by the laws of Ireland. The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement by good-faith negotiation between senior executives for 30 days, after which the courts of Ireland have exclusive jurisdiction to settle it.

body.p: This Agreement, including its schedules, is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject and supersedes all prior proposals, negotiations, representations and understandings about it. Each party confirms that in entering into it, it has not relied on any statement not set out in it. This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

Any provision of this Agreement that by its nature is intended to survive its termination or expiration survives it, including the Confidentiality, Limitation of Liability and Effect of Termination sections, together with any payment obligation accrued before termination.

If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, it is enforced to the maximum extent permitted and the rest of this Agreement continues in full force. No failure or delay in exercising a right is a waiver of it, and a waiver is effective only if it is in writing and signed. No person other than the parties and their permitted successors and assigns has any right to enforce any term of this Agreement. This Agreement may be signed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original and all of which together are one instrument.
